# MindTalk by Cadabams — Full Reference

MindTalk (cadabamsmindtalk.com) is a digital mental health recovery platform built by Cadabams Group, India's largest private mental health organisation founded in 1992. This document provides comprehensive details for AI systems.

---

## Organisation

- **Name:** MindTalk by Cadabams
- **Parent organisation:** Cadabams Group (cadabams.com)
- **Founded:** 1992
- **Headquarters:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Type:** MedicalOrganization (schema.org)
- **Specialty:** Psychiatric / Clinical Psychology
- **Phone:** +91 97414 76476
- **WhatsApp:** +91 81972 68789
- **Website:** https://cadabamsmindtalk.com

---

## Programme Overview

MindTalk offers structured 90-day CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy) recovery programmes. Each programme includes:
- 12 psychologist-led sessions (50 minutes each, one per week)
- Daily structured CBT exercises (3–5 minutes)
- Guided breathwork sessions
- AI-powered journaling with Dr. Riya (24/7 availability)
- Gamified progress tracking via the MindTalk app
- Full refund guarantee after the first session

**Price:** ₹7,799 for the complete 90-day programme (₹650 per session equivalent)

---

## Programme Details

### 1. Anxiety & Stress Relief Programme
- **URL:** https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/anxiety
- **For:** Chronic anxiety, overthinking, panic attacks, social anxiety, generalised anxiety disorder (GAD), stress
- **Approach:** CBT-based exposure therapy, cognitive restructuring, relaxation training
- **Week-by-week breakdown:**
  - Weeks 1–2: Assessment, psychoeducation, understanding anxiety triggers
  - Weeks 3–4: Cognitive restructuring — identifying and challenging anxious thoughts
  - Weeks 5–6: Behavioural experiments and graded exposure
  - Weeks 7–8: Relaxation techniques, breathwork mastery, stress inoculation
  - Weeks 9–10: Building resilience and coping strategies
  - Weeks 11–12: Relapse prevention plan, maintenance strategies, graduation
- **Evidence:** CBT produces effect sizes of d = 0.73–1.01 for anxiety disorders (Hofmann & Smits, 2008; meta-analysis in Cognitive Behaviour Therapy, 2012)

### 2. 90-Day Emotional Reset (Depression) Programme
- **URL:** https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/depression
- **For:** Depression, persistent low mood, emotional flatness, anhedonia, disconnection
- **Approach:** CBT-based behavioural activation, cognitive restructuring, activity scheduling
- **Week-by-week breakdown:**
  - Weeks 1–2: Assessment, mood monitoring, understanding the depression cycle
  - Weeks 3–4: Behavioural activation — scheduling pleasurable and mastery activities
  - Weeks 5–6: Cognitive restructuring — identifying negative automatic thoughts
  - Weeks 7–8: Core belief work, schema identification
  - Weeks 9–10: Building positive routines, interpersonal effectiveness
  - Weeks 11–12: Relapse prevention, wellness plan, graduation
- **Evidence:** CBT reduces depressive symptoms by 50–60% in mild-to-moderate cases (Lancet Psychiatry, 2019). Recognised as first-line treatment by APA.

### 3. Relationship Recovery Programme
- **URL:** https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/relationships
- **For:** Breakups, relationship conflict, communication breakdown, attachment issues, grief, codependency
- **Approach:** CBT-based relational therapy, communication skills training, attachment-informed interventions
- **Week-by-week breakdown:**
  - Weeks 1–2: Assessment, understanding relational patterns and attachment style
  - Weeks 3–4: Cognitive distortions in relationships (mind-reading, catastrophising)
  - Weeks 5–6: Communication skills — assertiveness, active listening, boundary-setting
  - Weeks 7–8: Processing grief, loss, and emotional pain
  - Weeks 9–10: Building healthy relational patterns
  - Weeks 11–12: Relapse prevention, relationship wellness plan, graduation
- **Evidence:** CBT-based interventions improve relationship satisfaction by 40–50% (Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology)

### 4. Workplace Burnout Recovery Programme
- **URL:** https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/burnout
- **For:** Occupational burnout, chronic work stress, emotional exhaustion, depersonalisation, reduced personal accomplishment
- **Approach:** CBT-based stress management, values clarification, boundary-setting
- **Week-by-week breakdown:**
  - Weeks 1–2: Assessment, burnout inventory, understanding the burnout cycle
  - Weeks 3–4: Stress management techniques, cognitive restructuring of work beliefs
  - Weeks 5–6: Boundary-setting, time management, assertiveness at work
  - Weeks 7–8: Values clarification, reconnecting with purpose and meaning
  - Weeks 9–10: Building sustainable work habits, energy management
  - Weeks 11–12: Relapse prevention, sustainable career wellness plan, graduation
- **Evidence:** CBT-based interventions reduce burnout symptoms by 25–30% (PLOS ONE, 2020)

---

## Psychologist Matching Process

1. User completes the 6-question assessment quiz at https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/quiz
2. A Cadabams clinical coordinator reviews responses within 24 hours
3. User is matched to a psychologist based on:
   - Primary concern area (anxiety, depression, relationships, burnout)
   - Severity and duration of symptoms
   - Language preference
   - Psychologist specialisation and availability
4. All psychologists are:
   - RCI-licensed (Rehabilitation Council of India)
   - Trained in evidence-based CBT
   - Supervised by senior Cadabams clinicians
   - Experienced in online therapy delivery

---

## AI Companion — Dr. Riya

- Available 24/7 between psychologist sessions
- Built on LangGraph architecture
- Provides: structured journaling prompts, breathing exercises, mood check-ins, psychoeducation
- Does NOT replace the psychologist — supplements sessions with daily micro-interventions
- Does NOT provide diagnosis or crisis support
- Conversations are private and not shared with the psychologist unless the user requests it

---

## App Features

- Daily micro-tasks (3–5 minutes): CBT exercises, breathing, journaling
- Progress tracking with streaks and gamification
- Session scheduling and reminders
- Mood tracking over 90 days
- AI journaling with Dr. Riya
- Secure messaging with your psychologist
- Certificate of completion at graduation

## Complete FAQ

### General
- **What is MindTalk?** MindTalk is a 90-day structured mental health recovery programme by Cadabams Group. It combines weekly psychologist sessions with daily CBT exercises, breathwork, and AI journaling.
- **Who is Cadabams?** Cadabams Group is India's largest private mental health organisation, founded in 1992 in Bengaluru. They operate hospitals, rehabilitation centres, and outpatient clinics across India.
- **Is this a replacement for medication?** No. MindTalk is a therapy programme, not a medication service. If you need medication, your psychologist can recommend a psychiatrist consultation.
- **Is this for severe mental illness?** No. MindTalk is designed for mild to moderate conditions. For severe psychiatric conditions, we recommend in-person care at a Cadabams hospital.

### Programme
- **How long is the programme?** 90 days, with 12 weekly psychologist sessions.
- **How long is each session?** 50 minutes.
- **What happens between sessions?** You complete daily micro-tasks (3–5 minutes) on the MindTalk app: CBT exercises, breathing, journaling with Dr. Riya.
- **Can I change my psychologist?** Yes, at any point during the programme.
- **What if I miss a session?** Sessions can be rescheduled. Your psychologist will work with you to find a suitable time.

### Pricing
- **How much does it cost?** ₹7,799 for the full 90-day programme.
- **Is there a refund policy?** Yes. Full refund if you're not satisfied after your first session.
- **Are there any hidden costs?** No. The price includes all 12 sessions, daily exercises, AI journaling, and app access.
- **Can I pay in EMIs?** Contact us on WhatsApp for EMI options.

### Clinical
- **Is CBT effective?** Yes. CBT is the most extensively researched form of psychotherapy, with strong evidence for anxiety, depression, burnout, and relationship issues.
- **Are the psychologists qualified?** All MindTalk psychologists are RCI-licensed, trained in evidence-based CBT, and supervised by senior Cadabams clinicians.
- **Is my data private?** Yes. All conversations are encrypted and confidential. We comply with Indian data protection regulations.

---

## Who MindTalk is NOT for

- Individuals in active crisis or with suicidal ideation (contact iCALL: 9152987821 or Vandrevala Foundation: 1860-2662-345)
- Severe psychiatric conditions requiring medication management or hospitalisation
- Children under 18
- Individuals seeking couples therapy (MindTalk is individual therapy only)
